name: Bad Münder am Deister (Germany)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the city arms of Bad Münder am Deister (a yellow lion on green under a red mural crown).
history: Municipal flag of Bad Münder am Deister; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bad Münder arms — lion with mural crown
